chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said: “Shaving the head outside of hajj or ‘umrah is a humiliation for your enemies and a beauty for you.”

And the meaning of this is in the saying of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله: when he described the Khawarij and said, “They pass out of the religion just as an arrow passes through the game, and their sign is complete shaving.”

key_terms.الْخَوَارِجَ: the Khawarij, an early sect described in hadith
key_terms.حَلْقُ: shaving; the act of removing hair from the head
key_terms.مُثْلَةٌ: a mark of disfigurement or humiliation
key_terms.يَمْرُقُونَ: they depart or pass out swiftly

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about shaving the head outside of hajj and ‘umrah?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes a statement to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning shaving the head outside the rites of hajj and ‘umrah. It then connects the meaning to the Prophet’s description of the Khawarij, whose distinguishing sign included complete head-shaving.
